setups.name: Hometrails - Season Opener
setups.notes: First proper ride of the season. Bike feels great.

setups.name: Bikepark Winterberg
setups.notes: Park day. Dialed the 40 a touch faster on rebound.

setups.name: Hometrails - post fork service
setups.notes: Fresh lowers oil. Fork much more supple off the top.

setups.name: Saalbach - Big Day Out
setups.notes: 2.000 hm uphill, all the trails. Battery to 8%.

setups.name: Saalbach - Hacklberg & Pro Line
setups.notes: Bumped shock pressure for the jump line. Felt poppier.

setups.name: Flowtrail Stromberg
setups.notes: Faster rebound for the flow trail. Switched rear to Dissector.

setups.name: Leogang - Worldcup Track (wet)
setups.notes: Rained overnight, dropped pressures for grip. Steep and greasy.

setups.name: Leogang - Speedster (dry)
setups.notes: Dried out. Added a click of HSC front + rear, more support.

setups.name: Mia - Hometrails
setups.notes: Softened fork a touch, was too harsh on the chatter.

setups.name: Bikepark Lac Blanc
setups.notes: Rocky and rooty. Added a token in the fork for big hits.

setups.name: Finale Ligure - NATO Trail
setups.notes: Loose over hard. Slowed rebound and firmed up for the long descents.

setups.name: Finale Ligure - DH Men
setups.notes: World Cup DH track. Front MaxxGrip for the steep tech.

setups.name: Finale - eMTB explore day
setups.notes: Legs cooked from yesterday, took the Levo to link up trails.

setups.name: Gravel - Kaiserstuhl Loop
setups.notes: 85 km loop through the vineyards. Lowered pressure for the gravel sections.

setups.name: Mia - Bikepark Willingen
setups.notes: Added a token + pressure for the big park hits.

setups.name: Hometrails - end of May reference
setups.notes: Back to my baseline trail setup. This is the one to beat.

setups.name: Bikepark Winterberg - after warmup
setups.notes: Fork diving on the big Winterberg jumps after a few runs, added a couple psi up front.

setups.name: Bikepark Winterberg - final runs
setups.notes: Chasing more rear grip for the last laps, dropped the rear tyre a touch.

setups.name: Saalbach - midday tweak
setups.notes: Long descents heating the fork, one click more low-speed compression for support.

setups.name: Leogang Speedster - refine
setups.notes: Track fully dry and hooking up now, bumped the rear pressure back up 0.1 bar.

setups.name: Finale NATO - lower rock section
setups.notes: A bit more high-speed compression to calm the fork through the rocky lower section.

setups.name: Mia - added a token
setups.notes: Mia bottoming the fork on the bigger jump line, added a volume token.

setups.name: Road - Neckartal Loop
setups.notes: Road wheelset on for a week. Cassette and tires come along with it, so only the pressures changed.

setups.name: Hometrails - angleset test (slack)
setups.notes: Flipped the angleset cup to -1°. Much calmer on the steep chute, a bit lazy in the flat corners.

setups.name: Hometrails - back to neutral
setups.notes: Angleset back to 0°, kept the lower bar. Best of both.

ratingEntries.name: Hometrails - back to neutral
